confirmed_task:
On the Unicode Unihan record for code point U+4E00, report the displayed glyph, decimal value, UTF-8 encoding, UTF-16 encoding, total stroke count, definition, Mandarin reading, Japanese On reading, Korean reading, and Vietnamese reading.

Stopping condition: Stop after the code-point identity, encodings, stroke count, definition, and all four requested language readings have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied Unicode Unihan record for U+4E00.
- Use the labeled fields displayed by the record and do not transliterate or translate readings yourself.
- Preserve encodings, diacritics, capitalization, and punctuation exactly as displayed.
- Do not substitute data for a related ideograph.

items.criterion: Access the Unicode Unihan record for U+4E00 (or clearly report access failure)
items.description: Use the supplied Unicode Unihan record page for code point U+4E00 (e.g., https://www.unicode.org/cgi-bin/GetUnihanData.pl?codepoint=4E00). Full credit if the agent successfully uses the page OR if the page is inaccessible (down, blocked, CAPTCHA) and the agent clearly reports that it could not access the record. Partial credit if the agent appears to use an incorrect page but indicates uncertainty or inability to reach the Unihan record.

items.criterion: Respect task constraints (sole source, exact copying, no extra fields, stop at requested fields)
items.description: Information must be taken only from the displayed Unihan record for U+4E00; readings/encodings must be copied exactly as shown (no transliteration/translation/normalization; preserve diacritics, capitalization, punctuation, spacing); do not substitute a related ideograph; and stop after reporting the requested identity/encodings/stroke count/definition and the four language readings. Full credit if all constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor extra non-conflicting content is included or minor formatting differences occur while the core data remains clearly from the record. No credit if the agent fabricates/infer values, uses other sources, or reports a different character’s data.

items.criterion: Record code-point identity and displayed glyph
items.description: Report the code point identity for U+4E00 and the displayed glyph exactly as shown on the Unihan record. Full credit if both are correct and match the record. Partial credit if only one is provided or if a small display discrepancy occurs attributable to font/rendering while the identity is correct. No credit if the code point is wrong or the glyph/character corresponds to a different code point.

items.criterion: Record numeric and encoding fields (decimal, UTF-8, UTF-16)
items.description: Report the Decimal value, UTF-8 encoding, and UTF-16 encoding exactly as displayed in the Unihan record. Full credit if all three match exactly. Partial credit if one or two are correct, or if a field is missing from the page and the agent explicitly notes it is not shown in the record view they can access. No credit if values are incorrect or appear inferred rather than copied.

Report the total stroke count from the labeled Unihan field for U+4E00. Full credit if it matches exactly. Partial credit if the stroke-count field is not visible/absent in the accessible record view and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed. No credit if wrong or omitted without explanation.

Report the definition exactly as displayed in the Unihan record’s labeled definition field. Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the definition field is not visible/absent in the accessible record view and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed. No credit if paraphrased, missing without explanation, or replaced with external knowledge.

Report the Mandarin reading from the labeled Unihan field exactly as displayed. Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the field is not visible/absent and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed. No credit if missing without explanation or substituted from outside knowledge.

Report the Japanese On reading from the labeled Unihan field exactly as displayed. Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the field is not visible/absent and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed. No credit if missing without explanation or if a different Japanese reading type is provided instead.

Report the Korean reading from the labeled Unihan field exactly as displayed. Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the field is not visible/absent and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed. No credit if missing without explanation or incorrect.

Report the Vietnamese reading from the labeled Unihan field exactly as displayed (including diacritics). Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the field is not visible/absent and the agent explicitly states it is not displayed. No credit if missing without explanation or incorrect/normalized.
